title: T2 | Setup failure in test_iface_namingmode.py
author: svelamal
body:
**Description**
The line up_ports = minigraph_facts['minigraph_ports'].keys() at https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/blob/master/tests/iface_namingmode/test_iface_namingmode.py#L41
 returns interface alias names in the form "Ethx/y/z" instead of interface names in the form "Ethernetz" 

As can be seen below, the actual interface names are in Ethernetz format and the script expects up_ports to be in this format
cisco@sfd-t2-lc1:~$ show int st
Interface Lanes Speed MTU FEC Alias Vlan Oper Admin Type Asym PFC
--------------- ------------------- ------- ----- ----- --------- --------------- ------ ------- --------------- ----------
Ethernet0 524,525,526,527 100G 9100 rs Eth1/0/0 PortChannel101 up up QSFP28 or later off

This causes failure at setup

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
Run iface_namingmode/test_iface_namingmode on T2 setup

**Describe the results you received:**
up_ports   = ['Eth2/1/31', 'Eth2/1/20', 'Eth2/0/18', 'Eth2/1/25', 'Eth2/1/23',...]
port_name_map = {'Ethernet0': 'TestAlias4', 'Ethernet1': 'TestAlias5', 'Ethernet10': 'TestAlias20',..]
>       upport_alias_list = [ port_name_map[item] for item in up_ports ]
E       KeyError: u'Eth2/1/31'


**Additional information you deem important:**

minigraph_facts['minigraph_ports'] gives interface name and alias both as the alias

minigraph_facts['minigraph_ports'] = {u'Eth2/1/31': {u'alias': u'Eth2/1/31', u'name': u'Eth2/1/31'}, u'Eth2/1/20': {u'alias': u'Eth2/1/20', u'name': u'Eth2/1/20'}, u'Eth2/0/18': {u'alias': u'Eth2/0/18', u'name': u'Eth2/0/18'}, u'Eth2/1/25': {u'alias': u'Eth2/1/25', u'name': u'Eth2/1/25'}, u'Eth2/1/23': {u'alias': u'Eth2/1/23', u'name': u'Eth2/1/23'}, u'Eth2/1/22': {u'alias': u'Eth2/1/22', u'name': u'Eth2/1/22'}, u'Eth2/0/27': {u'alias': u'Eth2/0/27', u'name': u'Eth2/0/27'}, u'Eth2/0/21': {u'alias': u'Eth2/0/21', u'name': u'Eth2/0/21'}, u'Eth2/0/12': {u'alias': u'Eth2/0/12', u'name': u'Eth2/0/12'}, u'Eth2/0/15': {u'alias': u'Eth2/0/15', u'name': u'Eth2/0/15'}, u'Eth2/1/29': {u'alias': u'Eth2/1/29', u'name': u'Eth2/1/29'}, u'Eth2/1/28': {u'alias': u'Eth2/1/28', u'name': u'Eth2/1/28'}, u'Eth2/1/19': {u'alias': u'Eth2/1/19', u'name': u'Eth2/1/19'}, u'Eth2/1/26': {u'alias': u'Eth2/1/26', u'name': u'Eth2/1/26'}, u'Eth2/0/24': {u'alias': u'Eth2/0/24', u'name': u'Eth2/0/24'}, u'Eth2/0/30': {u'alias': u'Eth2/0/30', u'name': u'Eth2/0/30'}}

linkedPullRequests.author: abdosi
linkedPullRequests.body:
Fixes:
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/issues/4981
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-mgmt/issues/5071

What i did:

```
  1. Updated library `port_utils.py` to be generic by get port alias data from device. Only Data needed for Connection Graph 
      need to be added for each vendor.

   2.  Added Change to get correct PTF Index Port in case of Multi-Asic
      where ports are distiributed randomly across ASIC's

   3. Fix the BGP Peer/Neighbor parsing in namespace context
```

How I verify:

After this change arpall test case is passing fine.
